_comment: Copy to hooks.json to run shell commands around tool use. 'match' is a tool name or '*'. A preToolUse hook that exits non-zero BLOCKS the tool (its output becomes the result). postToolUse stdout is appended to the tool result. Env: IMINI_TOOL, IMINI_ARGS (JSON), IMINI_RESULT (post only).

preToolUse.command: echo [hook] about to run a shell command: %IMINI_ARGS%

postToolUse.command: echo [hook] a file was edited; a real hook could run a formatter or linter here
